summary: Recent discussions in the Parquet community focus on extending the format with new logical types—VECTOR for fixed-size numeric vectors and WIRE for serialized wire-format messages—while a release 1.19.0 is also being discussed.

highlights.text: Adding a logical VECTOR type to represent fixed-size numeric vectors using MIN_LENGTH and MAX_LENGTH metadata

sources.title: Re: [DISCUSS] Numeric Vector type: physical representation (outcome of focused call)

highlights.text: Proposing a WIRE logical type to store serialized wire-format messages as opaque bytes with selective columnar shredding

sources.title: Re: [DISCUSS] WIRE: a logical type for serialized wire-format messages
